en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad tree‑lined street in a European city, showing horse‑drawn carriages, a few pedestrians, and late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings. On the left and right foreground are classical portico structures with columns and lanterns. In the background rise a large multi‑towered Gothic church or cathedral and, to its right, a Baroque‑style building with ornate roofline and a tall tower with an onion‑shaped dome. The scene is quiet and largely unmotorized, evoking a pre‑automobile era.
